use_cases.title: Complete a single-product purchase
use_cases.description: A customer purchases the Aurora Wireless Headphones through a single-product checkout by selecting a quantity between 1 and 9, optionally applying a supported promo code or an unknown code that yields no discount, reviewing a live order summary that shows subtotal, discount, tax, and total, and completing the purchase to receive a confirmation showing the exact amount charged.
use_cases.summary: Buy Aurora headphones with quantity, promo, live totals, and confirmation.
use_cases.value: Enables revenue-generating checkout with transparent pricing and an exact purchase confirmation.

cite.quote:
A single-product checkout for the Aurora Wireless Headphones ($40 each). The
customer picks a quantity, optionally applies a promo code, and sees a live
order summary before completing the purchase.

cites.quote:
A single-product checkout for the Aurora Wireless Headphones ($40 each). The
customer picks a quantity, optionally applies a promo code, and sees a live
order summary before completing the purchase.

The customer can set a quantity from 1 to 9. The subtotal is the unit price
times the quantity.

SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal; SAVE25 takes 25% off. An unknown code applies
no discount. The discount shows on its own line in the summary.

Tax is 10%, charged on the discounted subtotal. The total is the discounted
subtotal plus tax. Worked example: 2 units with SAVE25 is 80 minus 20 plus 6 tax
equals $66.00.
Completing the purchase shows a confirmation with the exact total charged.
